# A clean merge in progress in the host repository blocks akb's commits with a
# self-sufficient exit-2 refusal, reported before anything is written. The raw
# git fatal for a partial commit never surfaces.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

mkdir host
cd host
exec git init -q
cp ../base-file.txt base.txt
exec git add base.txt
exec git commit -m 'host base'

exec akb init docs --embed
stdout '^Initialized KB "docs" at .*/host/docs$'

# Both branches advance, so the merge is a real one; --no-commit stops it
# cleanly, with no conflict to resolve.
exec git checkout -b feature
cp ../feature-file.txt feature.txt
exec git add feature.txt
exec git commit -m 'feature work'
exec git checkout -
cp ../base-advance.txt base.txt
exec git add base.txt
exec git commit -m 'advance the base branch'
exec git merge --no-commit feature

cd docs

# A committing command refuses: this merge belongs to the host project, not to
# the base.
stdin ../../raw-data.csv
exec bash -c 'akb raw write data.csv; echo "akb-exit=$?"'
stdout '^akb-exit=2$'
stderr '^usage: commit preflight: merge in progress in repository .* akb commits are blocked until it is completed or aborted\. This merge belongs to the host project — do not resolve it from the KB; retry later or surface to the user\.$'
! stderr 'cannot do a partial commit during a merge'
! stderr 'internal:'
# The refusal is a preflight: the raw file was not written.
! exists raw/data.csv

# Completing the host merge unblocks the same command.
cd $WORK/host
exec git merge --abort
cd docs
stdin ../../raw-data.csv
exec akb raw write data.csv
stdout '^Written to raw/data\.csv$'
exists raw/data.csv
-- base-file.txt --
The host project's base revision.
-- base-advance.txt --
The host project advanced its base branch.
-- feature-file.txt --
The host project's feature work.
-- raw-data.csv --
raw content
